All five integrator initial values are supplied independently."}

{"task":"derive_control_dae","difficulty":"hard","control_units":["Filtered outer-voltage PI loop","Filtered inner-current proportional loop","First-order actuator lag","LC plant and load-current disturbance"],"inputs":["u_dqref","i_cdq"],"states":["e_vf,dq","xi_v,dq","e_if,dq","v_a,dq","i_L,dq","v_c,dq"],"outputs":["v_c,dq"],"differential_equations":["T_ov*d(e_vf,dq)/dt=u_dqref-v_c,dq-e_vf,dq","d(xi_v,dq)/dt=e_vf,dq","T_oi*d(e_if,dq)/dt=i_dqref-i_cap,dq-e_if,dq","T_e*d(v_a,dq)/dt=u_P,dq-v_a,dq","L*d(i_L,dq)/dt=v_a,dq-v_c,dq","C*d(v_c,dq)/dt=i_cap,dq"],"algebraic_equations":["i_dqref=K_pv*e_vf,dq+K_iv*xi_v,dq","u_P,dq=K_P*e_if,dq","i_cap,dq=i_L,dq-i_cdq","T_ov=5*10^(-5)","T_oi=3*10^(-6)","T_e=12.5*10^(-6)"],"notes":"dq denotes componentwise scalar channels: each of six state groups has two components when both axes are present. e_vf is filtered voltage-error difference, e_if filtered current-error difference, xi_v the outer PI error integral, v_a actuator voltage, i_L inductor current and v_c capacitor voltage. i_cdq is external load-current disturbance; i_cap is capacitor current. K_pv,K_iv are outer PI gains; K_P inner proportional gain; L,C are nonzero. T_ov=5e-5,T_oi=3e-6,T_e=12.5e-6 use the transfer variable's time units. For arbitrary original filter initialization, e_vf(t0)=v_rf(t0)-v_mf(t0) and e_if(t0)=i_rf(t0)-i_mf(t0); other initial states are retained. Only filter differences are used downstream."}

{"task":"derive_control_dae","difficulty":"hard","control_units":["Output-feedback PID governor","Output-limited valve integrator","First-order turbine","Generator frequency dynamics"],"inputs":["p_e"],"states":["w","m","z","q"],"outputs":["w"],"differential_equations":["w_dot=(m-p_e-D_pu*w)/(2*H)","m_dot=(x-m)/T_T","z_dot=(-u-x)/T_H","q_dot=K_I*w"],"algebraic_equations":["x=clip(z,X_min,X_max)","p_net=m-p_e","a_hat=(p_net-D*w)/(2*H)","u=(w+q+K_D*a_hat)/R","y=w"],"notes":"w is pu speed deviation, m turbine-power deviation, z unclipped valve-integrator memory and q integral command. x is valve position clipped to fixed finite X_min<X_max. The selected output-only clamp leaves z unbounded and evolving; its initial value may lie outside the output limits. Initial w,m,z,q are finite and supplied. H,T_H,T_T>0 seconds; R>0; D_pu>=0; D is an independent finite damping coefficient. K_I>0 inverse seconds and K_D>=0 seconds. Powers, speed, commands and valve coordinates share compatible pu bases. a_hat is the algebraic derivative estimate and equals w_dot only when D=D_pu. p_e is external electrical-power deviation."}

Inside each band the previous binary value persists; outside it the stated high/low transition applies. Initial relay states must be consistent with the current error. This is a hybrid realization with two continuous and three discrete states. T_dq_to_DQ uses external theta_slip; T_DQ_to_abc is a supplied consistent static transform convention. theta_p,theta_s are external phase signals. R10..R60 are complementary gate outputs."}
